evidence: Access to the track is signposted approximately 40 km northeast of Haast on SH6 at the Windbag Saddle.
The track up the Moeraki valley initially follows the Haast – Paringa Cattle Track.
The flat, well-benched track then follows the Moeraki (Blue) River to the Moeraki Valley Track junction, just before the swingbridge to Blowfly (Blue River) Hut.
Turn left at the junction, following the sign for Horseshoe Flat Hut.
Horseshoe Flat Hut will soon come into view on a grassy flat.
If it is safe to do so, cross the river and continue upstream over the gravel flats until markers indicate the beginning of the route through the bush again.
Middle Head Hut is located near the confluence of this creek and the Middle Head branch of the Moeraki River.

side_trips.name: Middle Head Basin
side_trips.quote: The side-trip into Middle Head Basin from the hut is worthwhile

doubts: Shape: the text never says the walker returns by the same track; one_way is taken because the way is described as ending at Middle Head Hut. The line 'you will be unable to return to Horseshoe Flat Hut' implies a return, but it is not stated as the way back, so this is a doubt. Start: F1 (where an unnamed track meets Haast Highway) is taken as the signposted Windbag Saddle parking area on SH6; the text names no road end, and the match is inferred from the location. The ford: the text says 'cross the river' without naming it; it is taken as the Moeraki River, since the page refers to 'the main Moeraki River' and this is the river the route follows. The creek from Zelian Saddle is said to have a 'crossing' but the text does not say to cross it, so it is listed as a via with no how. The Middle Head Basin route has its own heading and time, but the page calls it a side trip, so it is recorded as a side trip, not a way. The DOC time '2+ days' is the whole way's time. The section times (4 hr 30 min and 2 hr) are not summed.
